say:4:1029720003:1.text: Brutus is as dignified as ever. He really does have the presence of a true warrior!
say:4:1029720003:1.source_cn: 布鲁特斯大人还是一样威风凛凛，又充满了强者气度！

say:5:1029720004:1.text: Alsa held her own, too. She was a bit anxious at first, but you could see her confidence grow.
say:5:1029720004:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨也表现得很好，尽管一开始有点紧张，但后头就越来越...

say:6:1029720005:1.text: And Soren... well, he's still as quiet as ever, but just as dependable.
say:6:1029720005:1.source_cn: 索恩……索恩就还是一如既往地不怎么说话，但人还是很稳重。

say:7:1029720006:1.text: But y'know, something feels missing from this desert adventure...
say:7:1029720006:1.source_cn: 说起来，我总觉得，这次的沙漠之行，好像少了什么……

say:8:1029720007:1.text: Right? Bandit attacks, trade station management, moving cargo... There was so much going on...
say:8:1029720007:1.source_cn: 对哦，明明又是剿灭盗匪，又是经营贸易站，又是赶车拉货，...

say:11:1029720009:0.text: Just then, a loud voice calls out from the... back of the wagon?!
say:11:1029720009:0.source_cn: 正在此时，一个响亮的声音响了起来，方向是——货厢？！

say:15:1029720010:0.text: Ta-da! I, Mikola, seeker of all things exciting, spotted an opportunity—and found something much more fun!
say:15:1029720010:0.source_cn: 没错，那是因为最喜欢热闹的曼卡拉我，已经瞅准了时机，找...

say:16:1029720011:1.text: That's right, folks! Your favorite person Mikola has officially arrived in Holistone!
say:16:1029720011:1.source_cn: 各位，你们好吗！你们最喜欢的曼卡拉，来到圣石镇啦！

choice_prompt:17:1029720011.text: That's right, folks! Your favorite person Mikola has officially arrived in Holistone!
choice_prompt:17:1029720011.source_cn: 各位，你们好吗！你们最喜欢的曼卡拉，来到圣石镇啦！

say:18:1029720012:1.text: Back of the wagon, obviously! You weren't hauling that much cargo. I moved a few crates around and there was plenty of room to sit!
say:18:1029720012:1.source_cn: 当然是马车的车厢里，你们现在的货物运送量不多，我把箱子...

say:19:1029720014:1.text: Now then, you must be Rowan of the Mithril Consortium. Thanks again for everything you've done for the Ashen Wastes!
say:19:1029720014:1.source_cn: 那么，这位就是秘银商会的罗万少爷了吧！再次感谢您为荒角...

say:21:1029720015:0.text: Ah, think nothing of it. It was a mutually beneficial venture.
say:21:1029720015:0.source_cn: 啊，不用客气，这是合作共赢。

say:22:1029720016:0.text: In that case, I'm off to explore the legendary riches of Holistone!
say:22:1029720016:0.source_cn: 那么，我就先去传说中富饶的圣石镇游玩啦！

say:23:1029720017:0.text: As the saying goes: Mikola the Bold dives in first! Farewell, friends!
say:23:1029720017:0.source_cn: 正所谓，勇敢的曼卡拉先享受世界！朋友们，再会！

say:25:1029720018:0.text: Just like in the arena, Mikola gives everyone a boisterous greeting and then vanishes like a whirlwind.
say:25:1029720018:0.source_cn: 就像在擂台上一样，曼卡拉热情洋溢地问候了所有人后，犹如...

say:27:1029720019:1.text: Whew... Mikola's got enough energy for ten people.
say:27:1029720019:1.source_cn: 呃唔，曼卡拉小姐，还是这么有活力……

say:28:1029720020:1.text: You're not scared of her, are you, Rowan? Even Chippy gets nervous when she's that intense.
say:28:1029720020:1.source_cn: 你不会被吓到了吧，罗万？每次被她盯着看的时候，我也会很紧张。

say:29:1029720021:1.text: Not quite. Actually, something she said just sparked an idea.
say:29:1029720021:1.source_cn: 倒是没有，只是听到她刚刚的话，我产生了一个新想法……

choice_prompt:30:1029720021.text: Not quite. Actually, something she said just sparked an idea.
choice_prompt:30:1029720021.source_cn: 倒是没有，只是听到她刚刚的话，我产生了一个新想法……

say:31:1029720022:1.text: Hmm... hard to explain just yet. But first, we should check in with the Heroic Order.
say:31:1029720022:1.source_cn: 唔，现在还不好说，不过我们先去骑士团那边吧。

say:32:1029720023:1.text: Since Holistone's going to be our new base for trade expansion, we really should've reported to them earlier. But things went so smoothly in the desert, we just went ahead with the trade station.
say:32:1029720023:1.source_cn: 以圣石镇为起点开拓新商路，本来应该提前上报的，没想到荒...

say:33:1029720024:1.text: I suppose you could say we acted first and reported later. Time to fix that.
say:33:1029720024:1.source_cn: 我们也算是先斩后奏了，赶紧去和骑士团补充报备下才行。

say:35:1029720013:1.text: Right? I could've joined you guys up front, but this was way more fun!
say:35:1029720013:1.source_cn: 没错，虽然跟你们一起坐在正规的座位上也不错，但这次尝试...

choice:17:1:2.text: That's... certainly one way to travel.
choice:17:1:2.male: That's... certainly one way to travel.
choice:17:1:2.female: That's... certainly one way to travel.

say:0:1029721001:0.text: The General's not around. Let's talk to Valen instead.
say:0:1029721001:0.source_cn: 要去骑士团报备……将军这段时间不在，那还是找维伦吧。
say:0:1029721001:0.male: The General's not around. Let's talk to Valen instead.
say:0:1029721001:0.female: The General's not around. Let's talk to Valen instead.

say:2:1029723001:1.text: Been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'd love to grab drinks and catch up, but we'll have to do that later.
say:2:1029723001:1.male: Been a while, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'd love to grab drinks and catch up, but we'll have to do that later.

say:3:1029723002:1.text: After all, Master Rowan's here on official business. Honestly, if you hadn't shown up soon, I might've come looking.

say:4:1029723003:0.text: Is this about the trade report? Sorry, I didn't think things would move along so quickly...

say:8:1029723007:1.text: Normally, I wouldn't think much of merchants passing through. And your cargo didn't exactly raise eyebrows.

say:13:1029723013:1.source_cn: 虽然我知道你这样的出身肯定少不了看你不顺眼的和你看不顺...

say:17:1029723014:1.text: Exactly! Rowan kept everything low-profile. Someone knew way too early!
say:17:1029723014:1.source_cn: 对哦，毕竟罗万轻车简从，而且计划也比较简单，这么早送来...

say:18:1029723015:1.text: And those bandits were fishy too! Soren said they usually scatter at the first sign of trouble.
say:18:1029723015:1.source_cn: 说到这个，那些盗匪也很可疑！之前索恩说了，他们一般打探...

say:19:1029723016:1.text: But this time, they stayed right where we found them.
say:19:1029723016:1.source_cn: 但我们去突袭岗哨的时候，他们却还留在原地！

say:23:1029723017:0.text: Meaning they didn't get caught off guard. They already knew we were coming...
say:23:1029723017:0.source_cn: 也就是说，那些盗匪很可能并不是从岗哨处得知我们的到来，...

say:24:1029723018:1.text: Hmm. I've ruffled a few feathers, sure, both inside and outside the Consortium. We just wrapped up a big audit.
say:24:1029723018:1.source_cn: 唔，如果要说仇家，秘银商会内外我多少都有一些反对者，最...

say:25:1029723019:1.text: But I've got no clear suspect yet...

say:26:1029723020:1.text: Then maybe it's time to <style="highlight">lure them out</style>.
say:26:1029723020:1.source_cn: 个人建议，面对这种隐藏的敌人，要不要考虑把他们<sty...

say:28:1029723022:1.text: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> by your side, you've got all the security you need.
say:28:1029723022:1.male: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> by your side, you've got all the security you need.
say:28:1029723022:1.female: And with <style="stress"><player_name></style> by your side, you've got all the security you need.

choice_prompt:30:1029723023.source_cn: 唔，有道理，那接下来去哪里好呢……

say:31:1029723024:1.text: Right, that port that recently reestablished contact with the Empire.
say:31:1029723024:1.source_cn: 锈锚港？我有印象，是近期与帝国重新建立起联系的港口。

say:32:1029723025:1.text: Though most of what I've heard about it is wild tales. Sea monsters, Graveborn running around...
say:32:1029723025:1.source_cn: 比起贸易本身来说，现在大部分的传言还是关于海怪、亡灵和...

say:34:1029723026:1.source_cn: 那些倒也不全是传闻啦……

say:35:1029723027:1.source_cn: 不过，去锈锚港是个好主意呢！

say:36:1029723028:1.text: Traveling by sea makes us harder to track, and the Carmine Whispers keep tight control of the port. Any intruder would stick out like a sore thumb!
say:36:1029723028:1.source_cn: 坐船的目标很大，对方不好跟踪，而且血薇帮还控制着港口，...

say:40:1029723032:1.text: Alright, let's head to Rustport. I'm not that familiar with sea travel—but now's a good time to learn.
say:40:1029723032:1.source_cn: 唔，那么接下来就前往锈锚港吧，尽管我也没怎么组织过船运...

say:43:1029723033:1.text: Even while trying to find a traitor, you're still focused on business... classic Rowan.
say:43:1029723033:1.source_cn: 试探叛徒的时候也不忘做生意吗，真不愧是罗万……

say:44:1029723034:1.text: I prefer to think of it as efficiency. Why not do both?
say:44:1029723034:1.source_cn: 不如说是完成计划的同时顺便试试看能不能把叛徒钓出来，我...

say:45:1029723035:1.text: Just so we're clear, if I get another anonymous tip, I won't reveal the source. Professional ethics, I'm afraid.
say:45:1029723035:1.source_cn: 事先声明，如果有新的密告，出于职业道德，我是不会出卖消...

say:46:1029723036:1.text: But as long as I'm here, I won't let anyone in Holistone break the law in broad daylight.
say:46:1029723036:1.source_cn: 不过，只要有我在，至少圣石镇内不会有人明目张胆地进行违...

say:47:1029723037:1.text: Got it. Thanks for your help.

say:48:1029723038:1.text: I'll go get ready. The rest is up to you.
say:48:1029723038:1.source_cn: 那么，我这就去整理行装，接下来的行动就拜托了。

say:49:1029723039:1.text: Safe travels! I look forward to hearing good news from your next stop.
say:49:1029723039:1.source_cn: 诸位一路顺风，期待不久后再次听到你们开拓了新商路的好消息。

say:51:1029723031:1.text: With you on board, we're twice as efficient. No doubt about it.

say:52:1029723010:1.source_cn: 那当然了，大魔法师阁下。不过，仅限我能够做主判定的范围...

say:2:1029725001:1.text: After getting your letter, Lucca and I started preparing right away.
say:2:1029725001:1.source_cn: 收到你们的来信，我和卢卡就在准备迎接你们了。

say:3:1029725002:1.text: You arrived right on time. Seems like the tides are on your side.
say:3:1029725002:1.source_cn: 和预期的时间差不多，看起来最近航路风平浪静。

say:5:1029725003:1.text: It really has been. Everyone in Rustport has been looking forward to your return.

say:7:1029725006:0.source_cn: 你好，我是罗万，这次代表秘银商会，想要调查下锈锚港这里...

say:10:1029725009:0.source_cn: 棒极了，那么，我会尽快研究下你的计划书，并且整理出目前...

say:11:1029725010:0.source_cn: 至于货品……就在锈锚港内到处考察下吧，看看罗万有什么想...

say:14:1029748010:0.text: And with Cedartown's infrastructure and tourism experience, I think we can kick off a travel program too.
say:14:1029748010:0.source_cn: 而且，由于雪松镇在接待游客方面的渠道和经验都已经相当成...

say:17:1029748011:1.text: That's music to my ears! My inn has plenty of rooms waiting!
say:17:1029748011:1.source_cn: 那可太棒了！我的温泉旅店有的是地方！

choice_prompt:18:1029748011.text: That's music to my ears! My inn has plenty of rooms waiting!
choice_prompt:18:1029748011.source_cn: 那可太棒了！我的温泉旅店有的是地方！

say:19:1029748012:0.text: I guarantee it! No place in Esperia has better hot springs or tastier food!
say:19:1029748012:0.source_cn: 我敢保证，全世界都没有我这么好的温泉和美食，哈哈！

say:21:1029748014:1.text: Aside from Gerda's inn, we should organize a few welcome events to liven things up.
say:21:1029748014:1.source_cn: 那么，除去温泉旅店之外，雪松镇也应该组织一些迎接客人的...

say:22:1029748015:0.text: But the heart of this lies in trade. I'll start compiling a fresh list of Cedartown's specialties.
say:22:1029748015:0.source_cn: 而重头戏仍然在商贸上，唔，我会尽快组织人员整理一份新的...

say:23:1029748016:1.text: And we'll need to stock up for the Mithril Consortium's bulk orders.
say:23:1029748016:1.source_cn: 专供秘银商会大宗贸易的产品也需要提前备好货……

say:24:1029748017:1.text: Whew... I'm not the best at this sort of thing, but I'll do my best.
say:24:1029748017:1.source_cn: 呼，我在这方面并不算十分擅长，但会尽力而为。

say:27:1029748018:0.text: Don't worry, we'll give you our full support. That's why I'm here.
say:27:1029748018:0.source_cn: 请放心，我们也会鼎力协助。促进这次合作本就是我到此而来...

say:28:1029748019:1.text: Whatever problems come up, we'll sit down and work them out together.
say:28:1029748019:1.source_cn: 无论遇到什么问题，我们双方随时都可以坐下商讨。

say:31:1029748020:0.text: Next, we'll need someone in charge of keeping the routes safe and passengers comfy during transit!
say:31:1029748020:0.source_cn: 那接下来需要确定的，就是最初保证路线，监督货物运送及旅...

say:32:1029748021:0.text: Rodrigo, do you have enough people for that?
say:32:1029748021:0.source_cn: 罗德里戈，你那边应该有足够的人手吧？

say:33:1029748022:1.text: I should be able to dispatch a few squads to keep beasts and bandits off the road.
say:33:1029748022:1.source_cn: 数量上说，应该能调动几队卫兵来保证路线安全，驱逐野兽和盗匪。

say:34:1029748023:1.text: But the one managing the trade route should do more than fight. They'll need to keep travelers calm too...
say:34:1029748023:1.source_cn: 但我想，作为初期维护商路的人，应当更能应对不同的情况，...

say:35:1029748024:1.text: Most of our guards are fighters or order-takers. They might not be ready for something this complex.
say:35:1029748024:1.source_cn: 那些小伙子们恐怕大部分都只会战斗，或者听命行事，这种复...

say:37:1029748025:1.text: Hmm. Maybe Valka? She's great in battle, but she's not that familiar with the terrain.
say:37:1029748025:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡她虽然能率领卫士们战斗，但对往来的地形不是很熟悉呢……

say:38:1029748026:1.text: Plus, being a Graveborn... traveling between settlements might raise eyebrows.
say:38:1029748026:1.source_cn: 而且她毕竟是亡灵之身，在各地往来难免会有些不便……

choice_prompt:39:1029748026.text: Plus, being a Graveborn... traveling between settlements might raise eyebrows.
choice_prompt:39:1029748026.source_cn: 而且她毕竟是亡灵之身，在各地往来难免会有些不便……

say:40:1029748027:1.text: That's perfect! No one knows these roads better than him!
say:40:1029748027:1.source_cn: 好主意！这一带的道路法拉莫尔比任何人都熟悉！

say:41:1029748028:1.text: And he was super helpful when we first got here!
say:41:1029748028:1.source_cn: 而且我们刚到这里的时候，他也很温柔地帮助了我们！

say:42:1029748029:1.text: Hmm... but he's always lived in the forest. Wouldn't asking him to guide a caravan be a lot...?
say:42:1029748029:1.source_cn: 唔，不过他一直在森林里生活，拜托他来帮忙照看商队和旅客...

say:43:1029748030:1.text: Well, we won't know unless we ask! Chippy will go find him now!
say:43:1029748030:1.source_cn: 在这里纠结也没用，我直接过去问问他吧！

narration:44:1029748031:0.text: And with that, the ever-eager Chippy rushes off to find Faramor, while you and Rodrigo keep working out the caravan plans.
narration:44:1029748031:0.source_cn: 于是，通知法拉莫尔的工作交给了自告奋勇的满满，而你们则...

narration:45:1029748032:0.text: Not long after, a familiar figure appears on the horizon...
narration:45:1029748032:0.source_cn: 很快，熟悉的身影就出现在了视野之中……

choice:18:0:1.text: The highlight of any Cedartown trip!
choice:18:0:1.male: The highlight of any Cedartown trip!
choice:18:0:1.female: The highlight of any Cedartown trip!

say:47:1029748013:1.text: Absolutely! We've got bubbling hot pot and onsen eggs. Honey, they won't wanna leave!
say:47:1029748013:1.source_cn: 没错，还有热腾腾的火锅和温泉蛋，保证宾至如归！

choice:18:1:2.text: I'm sure the guests will love it.
choice:18:1:2.male: I'm sure the guests will love it.
choice:18:1:2.female: I'm sure the guests will love it.

say:0:1029749001:0.text: Sorry for the wait. I figured it was better to talk face to face.
say:0:1029749001:0.source_cn: 各位，久等了，关于商队的事，我想还是当面商讨一下为好。

say:3:1029750001:1.text: Chippy filled me in on the way here.
say:3:1029750001:1.source_cn: 来的路上，我已经听满满说过来龙去脉了。

say:4:1029750002:1.text: But I'm not sure I'm the right person. I've spent most of my life alone in the forest...
say:4:1029750002:1.source_cn: 我不太确定能否胜任，毕竟此前我一直在丛林间离群索居……

say:5:1029750003:1.text: Nonsense, Faramor! You're the perfect choice!
say:5:1029750003:1.source_cn: 不会呀，法拉莫尔，你是最合适的人选！

say:6:1029750004:1.text: You're smart, polite, and you know every trail and shortcut around!
say:6:1029750004:1.source_cn: 你又熟悉这里的道路，为人又风度翩翩——

say:7:1029750005:1.text: Plus, you've got serious strength and leadership skills too!
say:7:1029750005:1.source_cn: 而且战斗力和领导力都非常强！

say:8:1029750006:1.text: You're too kind... Refusing again would only be impolite.
say:8:1029750006:1.source_cn: 谬赞了……再继续推拒就显得太无礼了。

say:9:1029750007:1.text: If Cedartown needs me, I'll lend my support.
say:9:1029750007:1.source_cn: 既然是雪松镇的需要，那么我也会尽一份力。

say:10:1029750008:1.text: Yay! With this, our team's complete. We just need to prep the cargo!
say:10:1029750008:1.source_cn: 太好了！这样一来，这里的人手也准备齐全了，接着就只剩下...

say:11:1029750009:1.text: Let's go tell Valka and Carolina to get ready for guests!
say:11:1029750009:1.source_cn: 我们也可以去通知瓦丽卡和卡列琳娜他们，做好迎接客人的准备！

say:12:1029750010:1.text: Yes! That way, we can help the tourists settle in and maybe even soften people's prejudice against the Graveborn.
say:12:1029750010:1.source_cn: 嗯，这样既能帮助他们融入到雪松镇里，也能潜移默化地减少...

say:13:1029750011:1.text: Though we definitely need Valka to keep Igor in check. No more clowning around!

say:26:1029750019:1.text: Thanks to all your help, things are going even more smoothly than before.
say:26:1029750019:1.source_cn: 嗯，多亏了你们帮忙，这次的推进比之前更加顺利。

say:27:1029750020:1.text: I never expected Cedartown to be such a hit with tourists...

say:28:1029750021:1.text: Which means whoever's behind this didn't expect it either. They likely never thought you'd come here.
say:28:1029750021:1.source_cn: 既然你没想到，那么那个幕后黑手肯定也没想到——他或者她...

say:29:1029750022:1.text: Exactly. The fact that no one's tried to interfere says it all.
say:29:1029750022:1.source_cn: 是的，这次没有任何的阻碍和袭击就足以证明这一点。

say:5:1029755004:1.text: But Hugin said your plan this time is something completely new!

say:6:1029755005:1.text: Local goods flowing everywhere, travelers going place to place... just hearing about it got me fired up!
say:6:1029755005:1.source_cn: 又有各地的特产往来，又有旅客可以到处游玩，我一听就心动了！

say:7:1029755006:1.text: Our village has got things it wants to buy too, and hey, I like to get out and explore now and then!
say:7:1029755006:1.source_cn: 深岩村那边也有想采购的东西，更何况我自己也偶尔想出门逛逛嘛！

say:11:1029755009:1.text: If all goes smoothly with the trade developments, Holistone might see some changes soon too.

say:12:1029755010:1.text: Working with Brimstone Village... not a bad idea. Even I've heard tales of the scenic beauty in Ironhold Bay.
say:12:1029755010:1.source_cn: 和深岩村合作……嗯，是个好主意，峡湾的风光连我都有所耳闻。

say:13:1029755011:1.text: And you can try our forges firsthand—forging your own weapon is the full experience!

say:24:1029755020:1.source_cn: 别急，虽然效率至上，但这次的合作是通商往来，双方彼此的...

say:17:1029765013:0.source_cn: 很好的想法，我刚刚看了看地图，路线和商品都能保证。

say:0:1029766001:0.text: We'll see if the Uru Clan is open to direct trade with Cedartown.
say:0:1029766001:0.source_cn: 走吧，去乌尔氏族，问问那边是否愿意与雪松镇直接通商吧。

say:2:1029767001:1.text: Oh? What brings you here? Look how busy this place has become.
say:2:1029767001:1.source_cn: 噢？你们怎么来了？看，这里变得多么热闹。

say:3:1029767002:1.text: And lots of good stuff, too. I even ordered a new weapon the other day.
say:3:1029767002:1.source_cn: 而且有不少好东西，我这两天都忍不住下了新武器的订单。

choice_prompt:4:1029767002.text: And lots of good stuff, too. I even ordered a new weapon the other day.
choice_prompt:4:1029767002.source_cn: 而且有不少好东西，我这两天都忍不住下了新武器的订单。

say:5:1029767003:1.text: Direct trade with Cedartown? That sounds promising indeed. Alsa would finally catch a break.
say:5:1029767003:1.source_cn: 直接与雪松镇进行贸易？这太棒了，如果能实行，阿尔萨那孩...

say:6:1029767004:1.source_cn: 她在经营上遇到什么难题了吗？

say:7:1029767005:1.text: Quite. There's far too much paperwork involved with passing through Holistone, resulting in constant delays.
say:7:1029767005:1.source_cn: 和你们刚刚讲的雪松镇遇到的问题一样，货物通过圣石镇中转...

say:8:1029767006:1.text: Hmm. Cedartown is used to handling tourists, so they're at least efficient with the paperwork. But Holistone...
say:8:1029767006:1.source_cn: 唔，雪松镇毕竟是公国，也习惯于接待游客了，各种手续都会...

say:9:1029767007:1.text: And Alsa's handling everything here on her own. Guess I didn't think this through.
say:9:1029767007:1.source_cn: 蛮血这边就靠阿尔萨来组织……唔，确实是我此前思虑不周了。

say:10:1029767008:1.text: I'll pull more people to help out with the operations here.
say:10:1029767008:1.source_cn: 我会尽快调拨更多人手，来协助贵方运营的。

say:11:1029767009:1.text: Hahaha, that will be great. Tough conditions build character, and Alsa's grown a lot recently.
say:11:1029767009:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，那就再好不过，虽说越是艰苦的环境越能锻炼人，阿...

say:12:1029767010:1.text: But if she keeps going like this, I'm worried she'll collapse from overwork.
say:12:1029767010:1.source_cn: 但再这么成长下去，我都担心她会不会哪天累倒在岗位上。

say:13:1029767011:1.text: If she gets a break, she can travel more—she's been jealous of Lumont lately.
say:13:1029767011:1.source_cn: 如果能有人轮换，她也能到处去玩玩了——这些天她可是一直...

say:17:1029767012:0.text: Lumont went to Holistone! Huge place!

say:18:1029767013:0.source_cn: 和大家一起，坐索恩的车！

say:21:1029767016:0.text: He's been wanting to see new places for a while. After tagging along to Holistone, he's been drawing nonstop.

say:22:1029767017:1.text: Lumont, would you like to visit Cedartown? That's where all these blades were made.
say:22:1029767017:1.source_cn: 噜噜，想不想去雪松镇玩？看，就是这些刀剑铸造出来的地方。

say:24:1029767019:1.text: Of course! I heard the snow there is something else, not just the light dusting we see here in the desert when it snows.
say:24:1029767019:1.source_cn: 当然，据说那里到处都是雪，比沙漠里的小雪花可有意思多了。

say:26:1029767021:1.text: Lumont bought a bunch of new paints to draw many new things with!
say:26:1029767021:1.source_cn: 我买了很多新的颜料，可以画很多新的画！

say:27:1029767022:1.text: Hahaha, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan—looks like we're all ready to go.
say:27:1029767022:1.male: Hahaha, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan—looks like we're all ready to go.
say:27:1029767022:1.female: Hahaha, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Rowan—looks like we're all ready to go.

say:30:1029767023:1.text: Alright, I'll reach out and get the route opened up!
say:30:1029767023:1.source_cn: 嗯，我会尽快联络，开启两处的道路！

say:32:1029767015:0.text: Yes! Lumont wants to draw lots of new pictures!

choice:19:1:2.text: Want to go somewhere else next?
choice:19:1:2.male: Want to go somewhere else next?
choice:19:1:2.female: Want to go somewhere else next?

say:0:1029768001:0.text: Magister! Zanie just contacted us—she wants to meet us in Holistone!

say:2:1029769002:1.text: But guess what's the most popular item?
say:2:1029769002:1.source_cn: 但你们猜猜，你们这边什么东西在我们那最受欢迎？

choice_prompt:3:1029769002.text: But guess what's the most popular item?

say:4:1029769003:1.text: Haha, knew you'd guess that! Nope—everyone's working overtime, no time for that!
say:4:1029769003:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，我就知道你会猜错！抱歉，现在大家都在加班加点，...

say:4:1029769003:1.female: Haha, knew you'd guess that! Nope—everyone's working overtime, no time for that!

say:5:1029769005:1.text: Miners, smelters, blacksmiths—everyone's rushing jobs, they've barely got time to eat.
say:5:1029769005:1.source_cn: 如今无论是采矿的、冶炼的还是锻冶生产的，人人都在加班赶...

say:6:1029769006:1.text: Turns out the bread isn't just tasty—it gives them energy and keeps them going!
say:6:1029769006:1.source_cn: 没想到从你们这边采购过去的各种面包，不仅香，吃了以后人...

say:7:1029769007:1.text: Oh, right, I'm not just here to restock—I've got a request.
say:7:1029769007:1.source_cn: 哦，对了，我来这可不光是为了进货，还有个请求。

say:8:1029769008:1.text: Hugin said they just opened a new route, but they're running low on raw materials.
say:8:1029769008:1.source_cn: 呼金那小子说他那里前些日子又开了一条新路线，结果原材料...

say:9:1029769009:0.text: We had a chat, and it turns out we can cover their shortfall just fine!
say:9:1029769009:0.source_cn: 我和他私下一聊，发现我们这边正好能供得上！

say:11:1029769010:1.text: So you want to link up Brimstone Village and Cedartown directly?
say:11:1029769010:1.source_cn: 所以，祖娅你想让深岩村和雪松镇直接进行对接吗？

say:12:1029769011:1.source_cn: 没错，你真懂我，就是这个意思！

say:13:1029769012:1.text: Hugin and I go way back, and our goods match up perfectly—it's an obvious choice!
say:13:1029769012:1.source_cn: 正好我和呼金有旧，我们彼此的货物又有需求——这不是正合适吗？

say:14:1029769013:1.text: Honestly, I'm even thinking of asking Indris if they'd be open to tourism in Sal'thorin!
say:14:1029769013:1.source_cn: 实话说，我甚至还想问问因度厄他们，愿不愿意接待游客到他...

choice_prompt:15:1029769013.text: Honestly, I'm even thinking of asking Indris if they'd be open to tourism in Sal'thorin!
choice_prompt:15:1029769013.source_cn: 实话说，我甚至还想问问因度厄他们，愿不愿意接待游客到他们萨洛克兰呢！

say:16:1029769014:1.text: Yeah, exactly. I figured we'd take it slow—start with Brimstone Village, then gradually bring their people up here to get a taste of the outside world.
say:16:1029769014:1.source_cn: 是啊，所以我想着循序渐进，先从深岩村开始，再让他们的人...

say:18:1029769016:1.text: With a plan that solid, consider me convinced. Let's do it!
say:18:1029769016:1.source_cn: 你的计划这么完美，我肯定没有拒绝的理由——就准备开始吧！

choice:15:0:1.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
choice:15:0:1.male: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
choice:15:0:1.female: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.

choice:3:0:1.text: Has to be the wheat brew!
choice:3:0:1.male: Has to be the wheat brew!
choice:3:0:1.female: Has to be the wheat brew!

choice:3:1:2.female: Don't tell me... It's the bread?

say:4:1029777003:1.source_cn: 她们此前还说过，如果有空，想带达赫妮婆婆过来购物来着。

say:7:1029777005:1.text: For me, it's a bit too noisy. I prefer things a little quieter.
say:7:1029777005:1.source_cn: 对我来说有些太吵了，我更喜欢安静的环境。

say:8:1029777006:1.text: Still, things have been getting lively in the Dark Forest and Vaduso Mountains lately. Lyca and the others are busier than ever.
say:8:1029777006:1.source_cn: 不过，最近薄暮丛林和瓦度索山脉也变得热闹了许多，莱卡她...

say:16:1029778010:1.text: A festival? That's great news! Ravis and Annia will love it, and I bet Grandpa and Grandma will want to join too!

say:17:1029778011:1.text: We could even bring some coins to pick up a few things at the market...
say:17:1029778011:1.source_cn: 正好还能带上钱，在集市上添置点东西……

say:18:1029778012:1.text: No—better yet, I can sell some of my hunted game too... That's it!
say:18:1029778012:1.source_cn: 不、不止，还能去卖点我的猎物……就这么办！

say:7:1029779004:1.text: Hehe, well, I told them before we left: when they're out in public, they should behave themselves. And they actually do!
say:7:1029779004:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，毕竟这次出门前我就和孩子们说，出门在外必须乖乖的...

say:8:1029779005:1.source_cn: 索恩怎么没陪着你一起来？只有你吗？

say:9:1029779006:1.text: Soren's still busy protecting the traders. Brutus told me to take a break, so I brought the kids over for a little fun.
say:9:1029779006:1.source_cn: 索恩还在忙着照顾商队，布鲁特斯大人说应该让我放松几天，...

say:10:1029779007:1.text: And I figured I'd check on how our goods have been doing lately while I'm here.
say:10:1029779007:1.source_cn: 也是顺路看看这段时间我经营的成果嘛。

choice_prompt:12:1029779007.text: And I figured I'd check on how our goods have been doing lately while I'm here.
choice_prompt:12:1029779007.source_cn: 也是顺路看看这段时间我经营的成果嘛。

say:13:1029779008:1.text: Hehe, looking at the sales numbers is one thing, but it never feels quite real.
say:13:1029779008:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，光是看账目数字上说我们的货物销量很好，总觉得没什...

say:14:1029779009:1.text: But seeing people here actually selling our goods? That really hits home—in a good way.
say:14:1029779009:1.source_cn: 在这里看到有人在卖我们乌尔氏族的特产时，感觉就特别不一样啦。

choice_prompt:15:1029779009.text: But seeing people here actually selling our goods? That really hits home—in a good way.
choice_prompt:15:1029779009.source_cn: 在这里看到有人在卖我们乌尔氏族的特产时，感觉就特别不一样啦。

say:16:1029779010:0.text: Of course I'm in! I'll let Soren know right away—and Brutus too!
say:16:1029779010:0.source_cn: 这种热闹我肯定要来呀！我立刻就通知索恩他们……不，还有...

say:17:1029779011:0.text: Oh, and we're definitely buying lots of stuff. We're not going home empty-handed!
say:17:1029779011:0.source_cn: 不过，索恩倒是还好，布鲁特斯大人他们应该还在雪松镇观光...

say:18:1029779012:0.text: Soren should be here soon, but Brutus and the others are still visiting Cedartown... Not sure when they'll arrive.
say:18:1029779012:0.source_cn: 曼卡拉小姐更是不知道跑到哪去了！

say:19:1029779013:0.text: And Mikola... no clue where she ran off to!
say:19:1029779013:0.source_cn: 既然如此……就让索恩带上更多的货物，我们可不能空手而回！

say:21:1029779014:0.text: Since that's the case, we'll have Soren carry more goods back!
say:21:1029779014:0.source_cn: 阿尔萨已经越来越会做生意了啊！

say:22:1029779015:0.text: You're getting better and better at this, Alsa!
say:22:1029779015:0.source_cn: 那当然，我可是学什么都非常快的！

say:23:1029779016:0.text: Naturally! I pick things up fast!
say:23:1029779016:0.source_cn: 那么，我这就先离开了，回见——你们也加油哦！

choice:6:0:1.text: Looks like you've got them well in hand!
choice:6:0:1.male: Looks like you've got them well in hand!
choice:6:0:1.female: Looks like you've got them well in hand!

say:2:1029780001:0.text: Hehe, just pour some of this, then top it off with water... And boom! One bottle turns into three...
say:2:1029780001:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，只要倒点这个，再稍微加一点水，这一瓶就能兑出三瓶……

say:4:1029780002:1.text: Smokey! You're cutting corners again?! You're teaching Meerky all the wrong tricks!
say:4:1029780002:1.source_cn: 阿熏！你又在偷工减料！就不怕带坏蒙蒙吗！

say:5:1029780003:1.text: Meaning? This is how you turn a copper into a gold piece! Oh, hey! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the two familiars are here!
say:5:1029780003:1.source_cn: 说什么呢，这是必备的生活技巧——哎呀，是<style=...
say:5:1029780003:1.male: Meaning? This is how you turn a copper into a gold piece! Oh, hey! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the two familiars are here!
say:5:1029780003:1.female: Meaning? This is how you turn a copper into a gold piece! Oh, hey! <style="stress"><player_name></style> and the two familiars are here!

say:6:1029780004:1.text: Here to shop? Want this perfume? Potions, maybe? Pick what you want.
say:6:1029780004:1.source_cn: 是来购物吗？要不要香水？还是药剂？什么药效的都有——

say:7:1029780005:1.text: Tell you what, an extra 10% off and an extra bottle on me. So, what happened here, stays here, deal?
say:7:1029780005:1.source_cn: 这样吧，给各位多打一折，再送瓶赠品，刚刚的事就当做没看见——

choice_prompt:8:1029780005.text: Tell you what, an extra 10% off and an extra bottle on me. So, what happened here, stays here, deal?
choice_prompt:8:1029780005.source_cn: 这样吧，给各位多打一折，再送瓶赠品，刚刚的事就当做没看见——

say:9:1029780006:1.text: No bending the rules for me? Fine, fine, I'm going...
say:9:1029780006:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，您还是这么大公无私！那、那我这就告辞了——
say:9:1029780006:1.male: No bending the rules for me? Fine, fine, I'm going...
say:9:1029780006:1.female: No bending the rules for me? Fine, fine, I'm going...

say:11:1029780008:1.text:
You're not going anywhere!
Do you have a permit for this stall?
say:11:1029780008:1.source_cn: 不许逃跑！\n这次的通商，好像还没说让你到这里摆摊吧……

say:12:1029780009:1.text: Wait, you don't even have a stall... You're just peddling stuff out of your pockets!
say:12:1029780009:1.source_cn: 不止！你根本连个摊位都没有！就是一边走一边偷偷贩卖……

say:13:1029780010:1.text: I knew it. I'm telling Mikola!
say:13:1029780010:1.source_cn: 你果然又钻空子了，我要告诉曼卡拉！

say:14:1029780011:1.text: No, wait! If she finds out, I won't be able to take Meerky out ever again!
say:14:1029780011:1.source_cn: 哎呀，别别别！要是让她知道了，我就不能带着蒙蒙出来玩了。

say:15:1029780012:1.text: It's just... We finally got to take Meerky out on the road. And we saw business was booming here, so... you know how it is.
say:15:1029780012:1.source_cn: 这不是好不容易有这个机会，我带蒙蒙来见见世面，路上看到...

say:16:1029780013:1.text: Alright, just stop running your little shady business here. Actually...
say:16:1029780013:1.source_cn: 好啦好啦，你也不要在这里做自己的违法小生意啦，其实啊——

choice_prompt:17:1029780013.text: Alright, just stop running your little shady business here. Actually...
choice_prompt:17:1029780013.source_cn: 好啦好啦，你也不要在这里做自己的违法小生意啦，其实啊——

say:18:1029780014:1.text: Oh?! Now THIS is what I'm talking about! We're gonna get rich!
say:18:1029780014:1.source_cn: 哦？！这可是天赐良机！发大财的机会来了！

say:19:1029780015:1.text: But it better be legit! No rip-offs! Or we'll handle you ourselves before Mikola or Brutus even hear about it!
say:19:1029780015:1.source_cn: 但是要真材实料，不许弄虚作假！否则，不用叫曼卡拉和布鲁...

say:20:1029780016:1.text: Absolutely! Hehe, I'm an honest merchant. You know you can trust me!
say:20:1029780016:1.source_cn: 明白明白，嘿嘿嘿，我做生意最老实了，就相信我吧！

say:21:1029780017:1.text: Meerky, no more playtime! Let's go make some serious coin!
say:21:1029780017:1.source_cn: 蒙蒙，这次就别玩了，我们一起多赚点钱！

say:23:1029780007:1.text: You mean from the Heroic Order?! Wow, you're full of surprises... Right! Lovely chat! I'll just be... going!
say:23:1029780007:1.source_cn: 骑士团？！呃唔，您的兼职还真是多，那、那我就告辞了——
say:23:1029780007:1.male: You mean from the Heroic Order?! Wow, you're full of surprises... Right! Lovely chat! I'll just be... going!
say:23:1029780007:1.female: You mean from the Heroic Order?! Wow, you're full of surprises... Right! Lovely chat! I'll just be... going!

choice:8:1:2.text: I have knight friends, you know!
choice:8:1:2.male: I have knight friends, you know!
choice:8:1:2.female: I have knight friends, you know!

say:1:1029781001:1.text: Hey! I saw you from way over there!
say:1:1029781001:1.source_cn: 嘿，我老远就看到你们了！

say:2:1029781002:1.text: If you're not busy, maybe we could take a look around together?
say:2:1029781002:1.source_cn: 怎么样，要是没什么事，我们就一起在这边逛逛如何？

say:4:1029781003:1.text: Sinbad? What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be on your ship?
say:4:1029781003:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你怎么在这里闲逛呀，你的船呢！

say:5:1029781004:1.text: Ship's safe in port, of course. Lucca wanted to train some new recruits on escort duty at sea, so I grabbed the chance for some time off.
say:5:1029781004:1.source_cn: 船当然好好地在港口，因为二当家说想带带血薇帮的新人来护...

say:6:1029781005:1.text: But the whole Whispers crew is swamped with work, so if I stayed in Rustport, I'd probably just get dragged back to work.
say:6:1029781005:1.source_cn: 本来应该在锈锚港休假的，但血薇帮现在上上下下都忙得焦头...

say:7:1029781006:1.text: So, I figured I'd swing by, check things out, grab some gifts for the people back in Brineville, and hang out with you guys if you're free!
say:7:1029781006:1.source_cn: 所以就顺路过来，见见世面，给妈妈们带点礼物，能和你们一...

say:8:1029781007:1.text: But looks like you're in the middle of something. Anything I can do to help?
say:8:1029781007:1.source_cn: 不过，看你们的样子，似乎还在办正事？有什么我能帮忙的吗？

say:9:1029781008:1.text: Oh, it's alright! Enjoy your time off. But you're welcome to join us when things are set!
say:9:1029781008:1.source_cn: 不需要你帮忙，你只要能来参加就很好啦！

choice_prompt:10:1029781008.text: Oh, it's alright! Enjoy your time off. But you're welcome to join us when things are set!
choice_prompt:10:1029781008.source_cn: 不需要你帮忙，你只要能来参加就很好啦！

say:11:1029781009:1.text: Oh! That sounds interesting. I'll be there!
say:11:1029781009:1.source_cn: 哦！果然，你总能筹办各种有意思的活动，当然，肯定算我一个！
say:11:1029781009:1.male: Oh! That sounds interesting. I'll be there!
say:11:1029781009:1.female: Oh! That sounds interesting. I'll be there!

say:12:1029781010:1.text: I'll be the loudest one cheering and clapping, you'll see!
say:12:1029781010:1.source_cn: 到时候我会给你用力鼓掌和叫好的，你等着瞧吧！
say:12:1029781010:1.male: I'll be the loudest one cheering and clapping, you'll see!
say:12:1029781010:1.female: I'll be the loudest one cheering and clapping, you'll see!

say:3:1029782001:1.text: It's even livelier here than Cedartown during the Snowspire Festival. I'm almost overwhelmed.
say:3:1029782001:1.source_cn: 这里比祭典时的雪松镇还要更加喧闹，我都有些不适应了。

say:4:1029782002:1.text: Valka, is that really you? Chippy thought he'd mistaken you for someone else!
say:4:1029782002:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，真的是你！我还以为认错人了呢！

say:5:1029782003:1.text: Oh, I'm helping Faramor with some deliveries. I had some free time, so I'm just wandering around.
say:5:1029782003:1.source_cn: 嗯，我帮忙法拉莫尔运送货物，正好有闲，就在这里稍微逛逛。

say:6:1029782004:1.text: I disguised myself so my Graveborn form doesn't freak anyone out. That's why Sir Rodrigo's okay with me being out here.
say:6:1029782004:1.source_cn: 因为我能遮掩自己的外形，不至于因为亡灵之身引发外人的恐...

say:7:1029782005:1.text: The others are still in Cedartown. When I left, Carolina was planning to do some shopping here.
say:7:1029782005:1.source_cn: 其他人目前还在雪松镇，我离开时，卡列琳娜倒是计划着出来...

say:8:1029782006:1.text: It's still a long way to go before people get used to having Graveborn around, but honestly, this is already way better than I expected.
say:8:1029782006:1.source_cn: 毕竟要让大众熟悉亡灵还是任重而道远，现在这样已经不错了……

say:9:1029782007:1.text: So, have you picked up anything yet?
say:9:1029782007:1.source_cn: 那么，你在这里买了什么好东西吗？

say:10:1029782008:1.text: Of course. I've got gifts for everyone. I even met a young Mauler who recommended some great paints for me.
say:10:1029782008:1.source_cn: 当然了，给每个人都带了礼物，我还遇到了一位蛮血的年轻朋...

say:11:1029782009:1.text: He reminds me of Igor. He looks all grown up, but deep down, he's still a kid, though he's a lot better behaved than Igor, that's for sure.
say:11:1029782009:1.source_cn: 那孩子很像伊戈尔，虽然外表成熟，但内心还是个小孩子——...

say:12:1029782010:1.text: That's Lumont, the greatest artist in the Ashen Wastes! His paintings are amazing!
say:12:1029782010:1.source_cn: 那是噜噜，荒角沙漠的大画家！他画的画可好看了！

say:13:1029782011:1.text: Haha... I'm no art expert, but I can definitely feel it. So, I picked up a few of his pieces to bring back for Ludovic.
say:13:1029782011:1.source_cn: 呵呵，我不太懂艺术，但我也能感觉到，所以我带了些他的创...

say:14:1029782012:1.text: Who knows? Maybe they'll become friends. Communication's easier now with all the new trade routes.
say:14:1029782012:1.source_cn: 说不定他们之间会成为笔友呢——毕竟现在也有通信渠道了。

say:15:1029782013:1.text: Oh, by the way, Valka, we came to invite you...
say:15:1029782013:1.source_cn: 啊，对了，瓦丽卡，我们来找你是想邀请你——

choice_prompt:16:1029782013.text: Oh, by the way, Valka, we came to invite you...
choice_prompt:16:1029782013.source_cn: 啊，对了，瓦丽卡，我们来找你是想邀请你——

say:17:1029782014:1.text: Really? That sounds interesting! Then I'll stick around for your event.
say:17:1029782014:1.source_cn: 真的吗？听起来很有趣。那我就参加了你组织的活动后再走吧。
say:17:1029782014:1.male: Really? That sounds interesting! Then I'll stick around for your event.
say:17:1029782014:1.female: Really? That sounds interesting! Then I'll stick around for your event.

say:18:1029782015:1.text: I can even pick up some more souvenirs!
say:18:1029782015:1.source_cn: 还可以顺便再买一些新的伴手礼带回去。

say:1:1029783001:1.text: Hey, how are things going these last few days?
say:1:1029783001:1.source_cn: 嘿，你们这几天过得怎么样？

choice_prompt:2:1029783001.text: Hey, how are things going these last few days?
choice_prompt:2:1029783001.source_cn: 嘿，你们这几天过得怎么样？

say:3:1029783002:1.text: Figures. Once the plan's set, the organizer's pretty much hands-off.
say:3:1029783002:1.source_cn: 毕竟你是组织者嘛，只要方案确定了，就不需要担心了不是？
say:3:1029783002:1.male: Figures. Once the plan's set, the organizer's pretty much hands-off.
say:3:1029783002:1.female: Figures. Once the plan's set, the organizer's pretty much hands-off.

say:4:1029783004:1.text: I have handed off as much as I can to the folks in Brimstone Village. They're still figuring it out, but they're starting to get the hang of it.
say:4:1029783004:1.source_cn: 我现在已经把工作尽可能地都分给深岩村的那帮人了，虽然他...

say:5:1029783005:1.text: Too bad our village still doesn't get many visitors. But I've heard a lot of people from Sal'thorin are interested in checking it out.
say:5:1029783005:1.source_cn: 只可惜深岩村那边还是不太受游客欢迎，反而是萨洛克兰不少...

choice_prompt:6:1029783005.text: Too bad our village still doesn't get many visitors. But I've heard a lot of people from Sal'thorin are interested in checking it out.
choice_prompt:6:1029783005.source_cn: 只可惜深岩村那边还是不太受游客欢迎，反而是萨洛克兰不少人想上来看热闹。

say:7:1029783006:1.text: Yeah, he never misses the fun. But they say there's just too much going on in Sal'thorin to let him wander around much.
say:7:1029783006:1.source_cn: 没错，那小子一看就喜欢凑热闹，但说是萨洛克兰要管的事太...

say:8:1029783007:1.text: In the end, it's Indris who's stopping him from visiting. Funny how that works out, huh?
say:8:1029783007:1.source_cn: 结果反而轮到因度厄拦着不让他上来了。真是风水轮流转啊。

say:9:1029783008:1.text: Oh well, every place has its own issues.
say:9:1029783008:1.source_cn: 算了，一个地方有一个地方要头疼的事。

say:10:1029783009:1.text: But for now, I just want to forget everything and have some fun!
say:10:1029783009:1.source_cn: 但现在嘛，我就只想忘记一切，开开心心地玩一会儿！

choice_prompt:11:1029783009.text: But for now, I just want to forget everything and have some fun!
choice_prompt:11:1029783009.source_cn: 但现在嘛，我就只想忘记一切，开开心心地玩一会儿！

say:12:1029783010:1.text: Perfect! We can roam around, and when we bump into those Pointy Ears, we'll have plenty of stories to tell 'em!
say:12:1029783010:1.source_cn: 妙极了，正好可以到处逛逛，到时候给那帮尖耳朵讲讲，让他...

say:14:1029783003:1.text: Stop trying to do everything yourself. Let others handle some of it!
say:14:1029783003:1.source_cn: 你也太事必躬亲了，还是得放手给其他人！
say:14:1029783003:1.male: Stop trying to do everything yourself. Let others handle some of it!
say:14:1029783003:1.female: Stop trying to do everything yourself. Let others handle some of it!

say:0:1029784001:0.text: After inviting your friends, you notice a flash of light in your bag...
say:0:1029784001:0.source_cn: 邀请过来自各地的朋友们后，你注意到，包裹里闪过了一丝绚...
say:0:1029784001:0.male: After inviting your friends, you notice a flash of light in your bag...
say:0:1029784001:0.female: After inviting your friends, you notice a flash of light in your bag...

say:3:1029784002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's the bookmark again, and this time, it's glowing brighter than ever!
say:3:1029784002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's the bookmark again, and this time, it's glowing brighter than ever!
say:3:1029784002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, it's the bookmark again, and this time, it's glowing brighter than ever!

say:4:1029784003:1.text: It's beautiful. This is what it looks like in its true form... I can almost feel the mysterious energy inside.
say:4:1029784003:1.source_cn: 好漂亮，这就是它完整的样子……好像能感觉到里面神秘的力量。

say:5:1029784004:1.text: I get it now. It's glowing so brightly because of all our friends gathered here!
say:5:1029784004:1.source_cn: 我知道了，这次它能够全部亮起，是因为聚在这里的各位朋友！

choice_prompt:6:1029784004.text: I get it now. It's glowing so brightly because of all our friends gathered here!
choice_prompt:6:1029784004.source_cn: 我知道了，这次它能够全部亮起，是因为聚在这里的各位朋友！

say:7:1029784005:1.text: Yes, though we've temporarily parted ways, each on our own journeys, the time we shared and the bonds of friendship are still strong.
say:7:1029784005:1.source_cn: 是的，尽管暂时别离，各自经历着各自的旅程，但彼此共度的...

say:8:1029784007:1.text: Maybe we should still consult someone who knows more about this...
say:8:1029784007:1.source_cn: 不过，以防万一，还是去问问专业人士吧……

say:10:1029784009:1.text: How about we go ask her?
say:10:1029784009:1.male: How about we go ask her?
say:10:1029784009:1.female: How about we go ask her?

say:9:1029771006:1.text: Of course, I bet half those "public" numbers were cooked up in some shady backroom first.

say:24:1029771017:0.source_cn: 本次的成功少不了各位同仁一直以来的支持与援助，在此，我...

say:25:1029771018:0.source_cn: 但，我也很遗憾地想要告诉诸位，经过调查，我曾经遇到过的...

say:27:1029771020:0.source_cn: 甚至在查账初见端倪时狗急跳墙，联络其他商会的外部人员对...

say:28:1029771021:0.source_cn: 伴随着罗万的指控，不仅仅是秘银商会的参会者，其他围观的...

say:34:1029771011:1.text: How thoughtful. I used to think you were deliberately showing up only when I was on duty just to give me more work.
say:34:1029771011:1.source_cn: 真是善解人意。我之前都以为你是故意趁着只有我当班的时候...

cinematic_dialogue:32:1029772001:.text: Pinder! Got anything to say for yourself?!

say:2:1029773001:1.text: I-I don't—Master Rowan, I have no idea what you're talking about. I...
say:2:1029773001:1.source_cn: 我、我——罗万少爷，你在说什么，我——

say:3:1029773002:0.text: You stole from the company, took bribes from suppliers, leaked this year's business strategy—everything is right here.
say:3:1029773002:0.source_cn: 你在暗中挪用公款，收受供货商的贿赂，私下泄露本年度的商...

say:4:1029773003:0.text: These are forged! You snot-nosed brat, are you making your move on us long-time staff?!
say:4:1029773003:0.source_cn: 你这是栽赃嫁祸！你这个乳臭未干的小子，现在就想对我们这...

say:5:1029773004:0.text: Pretty sure you made your move first.

say:6:1029773005:0.text: You contacted a <style="highlight">certain friend</style>, and through her, you hired mercs to go after me, more than once.

say:7:1029773006:0.text: I have sent the evidence to the Heroic Order. And that contact of yours has turned on you—she's testifying for me now.
say:7:1029773006:0.source_cn: 相关的单据我已经提交给了骑士团，当然，也有你亲自与之联...

say:8:1029773007:0.text: T-this kind of thing... The knights wouldn't care, right? It's just a business dispute...
say:8:1029773007:0.source_cn: 这、这、这点事骑士团不会管的吧，只是些生意上的——

say:11:1029773008:1.text: You're right. Normally, we don't step into your usual fraud, kickbacks, or corner-cutting.
say:11:1029773008:1.source_cn: 啊，没错——虽然骑士团通常不会负责贪污、吃回扣以及偷工...

say:12:1029773009:1.text: But multiple assassination attempts on a well-known gentleman, the princess' future husband? Yeah, that'll get our attention.
say:12:1029773009:1.source_cn: 但数次买凶杀人，对象不仅是一位知名的绅士，更是公主殿下...

say:13:1029773010:1.text: Oh, by the way? We've already got the mercs, the transport contracts, even the weapons supplier. All in custody.
say:13:1029773010:1.source_cn: 哦，捎带一提，你雇佣的佣兵，提供的运输，甚至连武器的供...

say:14:1029773011:1.text: I've got my hands full here, so my advice? Just confess and make it easy on yourself—
say:14:1029773011:1.source_cn: 现在我忙得焦头烂额，建议你老实一点，乖乖认——

say:15:1029773012:1.source_cn: 混账东西！你们给我走着瞧！

say:5:1029775002:0.text: Let me see his face... Yep, it's Pinder alright.

say:8:1029775003:0.text: Oh my, if it isn't the honorable knight, the great Magister, and the young heir of the Mithril Consortium! I was just about to send someone for you, and here you are.
say:8:1029775003:0.source_cn: 啊呀，这不是我们可敬的骑士与伟大的大魔法师，还有秘银商...

say:9:1029775004:0.text: Some guy just collapsed <style="highlight">out of nowhere</style> right at my doorstep. Gave my maids quite a scare.

say:10:1029775005:0.text: I <style="highlight">have no idea what happened to him</style>. Really frightening, isn't it?

choice_prompt:11:1029775006.text: Not a chance. How could a perfectly ordinary lady like me cause a grown man like him to pass out?
choice_prompt:11:1029775006.source_cn: 无论怎么想，一个我这样的普通女性也不可能片刻就让一位壮年男子失去意识吧？

say:12:1029775006:0.text: Not a chance. How could a perfectly ordinary lady like me cause a grown man like him to pass out?
say:12:1029775006:0.source_cn: 无论怎么想，一个我这样的普通女性也不可能片刻就让一位壮...

say:14:1029775008:0.text: Oh? And this respectable, <style="highlight">ordinary woman</style> came out personally to check on an unconscious criminal, and no guard by her side?
say:14:1029775008:0.male: Oh? And this respectable, <style="highlight">ordinary woman</style> came out personally to check on an unconscious criminal, and no guard by her side?
say:14:1029775008:0.female: Oh? And this respectable, <style="highlight">ordinary woman</style> came out personally to check on an unconscious criminal, and no guard by her side?

say:15:1029775009:0.text: I told you—my maids were too shaken, and I'm nothing if not generous of spirit.
say:15:1029775009:0.source_cn: 都说过了，女仆们被吓坏了，我又向来宽以待人。

say:16:1029775010:0.text: As for the guards, I sent them to run errands... and inform the knights, of course. Is that a problem?
say:16:1029775010:0.source_cn: 至于护卫嘛，我派他们上街采购，并且去骑士团报信了，有什...

say:17:1029775011:0.text: You sure have an answer for everything.

say:18:1029775012:0.text: Dear guard, sometimes it's best not to overthink things. If the result's good, does the rest really matter?
say:18:1029775012:0.source_cn: 亲爱的隐士先生，有些事没必要追根究底，结果好就是真的好...

say:19:1029775013:0.text: ... Fair enough. Then allow me to ask—what brings you to Holistone today, madam?
say:19:1029775013:0.source_cn: ……有道理。那么，我顺便请教，尊敬的夫人，您为何光临圣...

say:20:1029775014:0.text: I've always liked it here. After all, this is where I first met the great Magister—remember?
say:20:1029775014:0.source_cn: 我一直很喜欢这里，毕竟我与大魔法师的初次相遇就在此处，...

say:21:1029775015:0.text: I have a soft spot for meaningful things—time, place, and all the memories they hold.
say:21:1029775015:0.source_cn: 我喜欢一切有纪念意义的事物，时间与地点当然也包含在内。
say:21:1029775015:0.male: I have a soft spot for meaningful things—time, place, and all the memories they hold.
say:21:1029775015:0.female: I have a soft spot for meaningful things—time, place, and all the memories they hold.

say:22:1029775016:0.text: But right now? I'm here because things have gotten delightfully busy.
say:22:1029775016:0.source_cn: 当然，此时此刻则是因为——这里变得格外热闹了。

choice_prompt:23:1029775017.text: Exactly! So many treasures gathered from all corners of the land—who could resist?
choice_prompt:23:1029775017.source_cn: 正是，来自各地的丰富珍宝汇聚于此，没有人能抗拒这种诱惑的，不是吗？

say:24:1029775017:0.text: Exactly! So many treasures gathered from all corners of the land—who could resist?
say:24:1029775017:0.source_cn: 正是，来自各地的丰富珍宝汇聚于此，没有人能抗拒这种诱惑...

say:25:1029775019:0.text: Getting to experience so much in one place, it's all because of your hard work. You have my thanks.
say:25:1029775019:0.source_cn: 能在这里体验各地的不同风貌，这也是多亏了诸位的努力，在...

say:26:1029775020:0.text: Now then, I'll take my leave. Plenty more wares are waiting for me.
say:26:1029775020:0.source_cn: 那么，我就先告辞了，还有很多集市等着我去逛呢。

say:30:1029775022:0.text: Alright then. At least we caught our guy. I'll take him to the knights for processing.
say:30:1029775022:0.source_cn: 算了，至少抓到了犯人，也不算一无所获。我带他去骑士团那...

say:31:1029775023:0.text: Rowan, don't leave Holistone just yet. The knights might follow up on the evidence you submitted.
say:31:1029775023:0.source_cn: 罗万少爷，你暂时不要离开圣石镇，骑士团之后或许会对你提...

say:32:1029775024:0.text: Understood. I'll give them my full cooperation. And thanks for your support.
say:32:1029775024:0.source_cn: 明白了，我会全力配合，也感谢骑士团的鼎力相助。

say:35:1029775026:0.source_cn: 唔，这样一来，暂时就没什么事做了。

say:36:1029775027:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I don't really feel like sitting still. Lady Vala's words just sparked an idea.

say:37:1029775028:0.source_cn: 各地的特产，各地的游客，此时此刻正汇聚于此，为什么不顺...

say:42:1029775031:0.text: That already sounds amazing! Let's help make it happen, Magister!
say:42:1029775031:0.source_cn: 听起来就很有趣！我们一起去办吧，主人！

say:43:1029775032:0.source_cn: 正好现在广场来了不少以前的朋友，顺路去邀请下如何？

say:48:1029775018:0.source_cn: 虽然有些杂乱喧嚣，但来自各地的风土人情依旧令我颇为向往。
